SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah… I’m sorry for startling you!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あっ…驚かせてしまってすみません！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah… desculpa, não quis te assustar.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه ... متاسفم که شما را غافلگیر کردم!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 제가 물을 잘못 틀은어가지고 지금 바로 다시 청소 할게요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I must’ve turned the water wrong… I’ll clean it up right away.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 是我不小心开错水龙头...我马上重新打扫
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我不小心轉錯水龍頭... 現在馬上重新打掃
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私が水を間違えて出しちゃって…すぐ掃除やり直します！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kayaknya aku salah muter airnya… aku bersihin sekarang juga.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Abri errado a torneira e molhou tudo. Vou limpar já.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Abrí mal el grifo y se mojó todo. Voy a limpiar de inmediato.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: حتماً آب را اشتباه کرده‌ام... فوراً اونو تمیز می‌کنم.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니, 이렇게 젖어 놓곤 무슨 청소예요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, how are you supposed to clean after getting yourself this soaked?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 都湿成这样了，还打扫什么呀！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 都濕成這樣了，還打掃什麼！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや、こんなに濡れたまま掃除なんてダメですよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak, kamu basah kuyup gitu gimana mau bersih-bersih?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Limpar assim, toda encharcada? Nem pense nisso!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، بعد از اینکه اینقدر خیس شدی چطوری باید تمیز کنی؟!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: とにかく、まずは着替えてください
パ、パク・ミンジョンさん！？

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kok kamu bisa ada di sini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que você tá fazendo aqui?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ll explain later! Just change your clothes first.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 待会儿再解释！先换衣服吧
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 等等再解釋！妳先去換衣服
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 説明はあとで！とにかく着替えましょう
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nanti aku jelasin! Sekarang ganti baju dulu aja.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Depois te explico. Primeiro se troca.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بعدا توضیح میدم! فقط اول لباستو عوض کن
چند لباس به تو قرض می دهم
